query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64"
               FROM local_users u
               WHERE u.role = 'admin'
                 AND u.status = 'active'
                 AND u.id <> $1
                 AND (u.password_hash IS NOT NULL
                      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM local_user_identities i WHERE i.user_id = u.id))
